source.notes: ThreadSafeRandom seeded with new System.Random(seed) by reflection; the player is 0x50000001 with in.level (null = unset), AugmentationLessDeathItemLoss in.aug, CoinValue in.coins and PlayerKillerStatus in.pk_status; the corpse's KillerId is in.killer (null = unset). out.items and out.coins are the two results; out.next is ThreadSafeRandom.Next(0, 1000000) after them, which shows how many draws they made.
